name: Airtable
summary: Flexible database and workflow platform for non-technical business teams.
overview: Airtable lets teams build customized databases and business workflows.
bull_case: A flexible platform can replace bespoke spreadsheets and fragmented tools.
bear_case: Product complexity and platform competition may slow large-scale deployment.

intelligence.description: Airtable is a collaborative application-building and workflow platform that brought spreadsheet-like interfaces to structured business data.
company: Airtable lets teams build databases, internal applications and workflows without conventional software development for every use case.
The company shifted toward an AI-native product strategy before Bending Spoons agreed to acquire it in 2026.
intelligence.why_it_matters: Airtable's exit is an important mark for the no-code and collaboration-software cohort. It shows how far late-stage private software valuations can move when growth expectations reset.

changed.text: Introduced an AI-native product direction for app-building workflows.
Bending Spoons agreed to acquire Airtable in an all-cash transaction.

takeaways: The agreed exit is a meaningful reset from Airtable's 2021 private-market peak.
Its product remains an important reference point for AI-assisted business software.
Closing conditions and integration will determine the final outcome.
